Prior NATIVE_TAIL_V01 and ELIGIBILITY_V01 used a pinned raw reader after fresh memory descent; their accepted native scope is retained, but they do not establish the ordinary TaskStore reader seam.
New source uses the existing typed inert ordinary producer only offline. No synthetic role result is an owner model boundary or real provider response.
Original ORDINARY_V02 primary reason remains UNKNOWN. A new ordinary-reader result may identify its own cause but cannot reconstruct the old lost exception.
Explicit history-only evaluation clocks do not assert wall-time aging or renew original TTL/valid_to. Conflict/quarantine remain restrictions and expired history is not opened.
All v01 actuals, reviews, pins, failed runs and reservation remain untouched. No model, AUTH, E, SAVE, public push or owner actual was run in preparing this matrix.
